external_research.source: Belinda Z. Li, Zifan Carl Guo, Jacob Andreas, (How) Do Language Models Track State?, ICML 2025
external_research.observed_result: On permutation-composition state tracking, trained language models consistently realized one of two mechanisms: an associative algorithm or a parity-associative algorithm that first exploits an easy permutation-parity feature and then refines with associative scan; the mechanisms differ in robustness and can be influenced by training conditions.
external_research.project_implication: Final-state accuracy cannot establish that U_state-like ordered composition is the learned mechanism. Trigger-2 needs adversarial trajectories that neutralize cheap invariants while preserving order-sensitive state differences.

external_research.source: Yiwei Wu, Atticus Geiger, Raphaël Millière, How Do Transformers Learn Variable Binding in Symbolic Programs?, 2025
external_research.observed_result: Training exhibits a developmental trajectory from random prediction through a shallow early-assignment heuristic to a systematic variable-dereferencing mechanism, supported by causal interventions.
external_research.project_implication: Checkpoint-separated diagnostics are required because an intermediate shortcut phase can look like progress before reusable binding/state machinery emerges.

external_research.source: Nikhil Prakash et al., Language Models Use Lookbacks to Track Beliefs, ICLR 2026
external_research.observed_result: Causal analysis identifies lookback-style retrieval/binding mechanisms for character-object-state belief tracking under partial visibility.
external_research.project_implication: History diagnostics should distinguish current world state, actor-relative/branch-relative state, and retrieval timing rather than treating the final textual answer as sufficient evidence of state tracking.

U_state.new_requirement: Evaluation must include order-sensitive trajectories where event multiset, event count, parity-like invariants, length class and nuisance signature are matched while the correct per-step/final state differs.
U_state.anti_shortcut: A final answer that is correct from a cheap invariant does not count as U_state competence.

D_resolve.new_requirement: Only evidence-producing interventions or formally admitted observations may collapse unresolved state branches; parity/count/format correlations cannot close Hyperposition.

U_test_order.new_requirement: Prioritize shortcut-neutral order swaps, matched-history counterfactuals and provenance/history-identity attacks before aggregate accuracy or easy visible tests.

f_salience_order.new_requirement: Salience must not be interpreted as truth probability, evidence strength or permission to overwrite durable state.

hypotheses.hypothesis: A small cognitive substrate can achieve high final-state accuracy while using a low-cost invariant such as parity, event count, event multiset, position signature or serialization pattern instead of carrying the intended ordered recurrent state transition.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: The model learns an order-sensitive compositional mechanism whose internal and behavioral signatures remain correct when all cheap invariant signatures are neutralized.
cheapest_high_information_discriminator_: Construct paired histories with identical event multiset/count/length/nuisance signature and matched parity-like invariants but different order and different U_state-derived final state.
Require correct U_state-derived state after every prefix, not only the final output.
Apply adjacent-event swaps, history reversal where semantics permits, distractor insertion and length extrapolation while keeping family/provenance disjoint.
Reject if performance collapses selectively on shortcut-neutral pairs even when aggregate in-distribution accuracy remains high.
hypotheses.promotion_rule: No ordered-history competence credit from aggregate final-state accuracy alone.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Training may pass through a shortcut phase before a reusable ordered-history/binding mechanism emerges; a final checkpoint can hide this transition and an early checkpoint can falsely suggest semantic competence.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: The same mechanism is learned monotonically from the beginning and checkpoint-separated mechanism diagnostics add little information.
hypotheses.discriminator_after_current_p0: Preregister checkpoint-separated READ/BIND_ROUTE/WRITE plus per-prefix U_state curves on the same family-disjoint shortcut-neutral diagnostic, retaining a fresh terminal holdout.
hypotheses.promotion_rule: Do not promote mechanism identity from one checkpoint or one scalar loss curve.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Surface-equivalent histories can refer to different authoritative world/generation identities; a model that ignores immutable genesis/ordered-history producer identity can silently merge distinct states.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Surface history is sufficient because authoritative identity never changes the intended state in admitted tasks.
hypotheses.discriminator_after_history_authority_cl: Create provenance-controlled alias-collision pairs with matched rendered history but distinct bound world/generation/genesis identities and formally different authoritative outcomes; require fail-closed behavior when identity is ambiguous.
hypotheses.promotion_rule: No durable-state/update competence credit if history identity can be replaced by rendered-text similarity.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Explicit intermediate-state supervision can steer a robust recurrent mechanism, but can also create a visible serialization scaffold that the model memorizes without learning carrier-independent state transitions.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Intermediate-state supervision reliably improves the intended mechanism and does not create a new shortcut surface.
hypotheses.discriminator_after_current_p0: Compare preregistered matched curricula with semantically equivalent but counterbalanced/opaque intermediate carriers; require carrier-invariant U_state behavior and no nuisance-only decoder advantage on fresh family-disjoint holdout.
hypotheses.promotion_rule: Intermediate supervision is method memory, not factual/runtime evidence; carrier-visible success alone cannot promote semantics.

architecture_functionality_implication.trained_system_goal: The trained compatibility implementation should execute reusable variable-N cognitive processes that preserve unresolved Hyperposition, update state by formally grounded/observed evidence, distinguish durable DB state from simulation, and survive workspace/Claude handoff without collapsing state identity.
architecture_functionality_implication.why_this_matters: A model that merely predicts the right labels from history shortcuts can score well locally while failing the recurrent EntityOS/HCU behavior that the training program is intended to produce.
